searchText: After the merge will we have more guarantees about block.timestamp in a contract, or can it still be moved around by block producers like miners can now? The block timestamp must be the start time for the slot. I can’t link anything sorry, this was something I came across during very early merge testnets. <@360491619402776577> geth used to reject `0x00...00` (all zeroes) as a `feeRecipient` value. Is it still the case? I don't think we ever did. We only refuse to start a miner pre-merge without setting the etherbase oh, I see Life has been getting in the way a little and haven't been able to completely keep abreast of everything here... I would like to setup Prysm/Geth on Kiln now... are there any guides? I seem to remember one somebody produced early on that looked quite good but perhaps it is now deprecated. Also, I'd be grateful for any info on how to participate in any upcoming shadow forks once I'm all synced... The best way to stay tuned on shadow forks is to follow <#892088344438255616> channel (for example, https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/892088344438255616/966727650720763926) Here is information about Kiln https://kiln.themerge.dev with a link to how to run a node
